01 / A little introduction

Operations-minded.
Data-focused.

A practical FM professional with a technical foundation and a growing focus on planning, reporting and process improvement.

My career started as an HVAC technician in Saudi Arabia, where I learned how facilities run on the ground: equipment, people, priorities, and why every job needs to be properly closed.

From the site I moved into CAFM, managing work orders in IBM Maximo. Next I joined Musanadah as an admin, handling attendance, timesheets, leave, documentation, work orders in Hexagon EAM, and store and client coordination. Today, as a Reporting & Planning Officer, I plan maintenance work and prepare the reports that make operational information easy to understand and act on.

I enjoy building useful tools, simplifying repetitive reporting, and giving teams a clear picture of what is pending, where it is stuck and what needs attention next.

03 / Practical problem-solving

Things I build
to make work flow.

A dashboard and a planning tool, built for real site operations. Demos are in All my works.

▦
Operational visibility

Management Dashboard

Everything related to site operations in one place, so teams don't have to chase information across separate files and emails.

  • 400,000+ work orders
  • Procurement, warehouse and payment status
  • Stage-wise pending: where, with whom, for how long
  • Action history: who did what, and when
  • Separate Management, Engineer and Client views
▥
Maintenance planning

52 Week PM Plan Builder

Builds a complete 52-week preventive maintenance plan from the Maximo asset list, ready to load back into Maximo. It works offline in the browser.

  • Matches every asset to the right job plan and frequency
  • Skips assets that already have a PPM, and fills building, zone and location
  • Flags anything that needs a planner's check before going further
  • Creates routes, PM numbers and a colour-coded 52-week plan
  • Gives ready ROUTES and PM sheets for Maximo upload

07 / Beyond the job title

Curious by nature.
Builder by habit.

What I'm like to work with, beyond the CV.

I came from the field. I started on site as an HVAC technician, moved into CAFM operations with IBM Maximo, then worked as a site admin, and today I work in reporting and planning. At every step I learned something new. When something at work is slow, repeated or hard to follow, I look for a better way to do it.

🌱

Always learning

From site work to IBM Maximo and Hexagon EAM, then PM planning, PM scheduling, making reports, building dashboards and working with AI tools, I keep picking up new skills on the job. I also keep adding certifications in project management, operations and safety alongside full-time work.

💡

Full of ideas

I'm always thinking about how work could flow better. My Management Dashboard started as a way to chase pending work and the people responsible for it. To do that, I used to check multiple files, emails and Maximo again and again. Today the dashboard brings the whole operation into one place: 400,000+ work orders with their procurement, warehouse and payment status, the stage each job is at, who it is pending with and for how long, and who took which action and when. Management, engineers and the client each get their own view.

🔧

Grounded in the field

Years on site taught me how technicians, engineers and supervisors actually work. That's why my plans and reports are practical, not just neat on paper.
